title: The Gospel of John in 21 Days
description: Read through the Gospel of John in three weeks — roughly one chapter per day. Each day pairs the reading with a single reflection prompt to carry through your day.

days.prompt: Where did you sense light today, even in unexpected places?
Who in your life is helping you 'come and see'?
What is Jesus inviting you to bring to him today?
What does being 'born again' look like in your life right now?
Whom do you find yourself avoiding that Jesus might be sending you toward?
What healing — physical or otherwise — are you longing for?
Where are you running on small bread when you've been offered more?
What hard teaching of Jesus would you walk away from if you could?
Where have you confused popular acclaim with God's approval?
Who has thrown stones at you that Jesus would have set down?
What truth might set you free that you've been avoiding?
What blind spot are you ready to admit to today?
Whose voice are you most attuned to right now?
What 'tomb' in your life has Jesus not yet been invited into?
What costly act of devotion is being asked of you?
Whose feet are yours to wash this week?
What troubled corner of your heart is Jesus speaking peace into?
Where are you trying to bear fruit while disconnected from the vine?
What grief is Jesus promising to turn into joy?
Where is Jesus inviting you into the cost of love?
What 'do you love me?' question is Jesus asking you, and what is your honest answer?
